li.label: her face in the water
li.description: The moon was lying in the still water, bright as a face, though the moon itself was behind me. I stood there a long while and it was very quiet.

li.label: the moon kept me company
li.description: I kept the night out of doors, and the moonlight sat with me the whole time. I could see further than I ever do at night.

li.label: kept the dark face
li.description: There was no moon, so I stood at the door and kept the night myself. Nothing came in while I was there.

HediffDef.label: moonlit watch
HediffDef.description: The moonlight keeps them company on their watch. They see further than they should at night, and their aim is steady.

plain.li: [morning,morning:found] There's {THING} by my bed that I've never seen before.
[morning,morning:found] Somebody left {THING} by my bed, and nobody will say who.
[morning,morning:found,named] {GOD} gave it back, the thing I did yesterday.
[morning,morning:gooddream] I dreamt of a silver road all night, and I woke up happy.
[morning,morning:gooddream] I had the kindest dream, like someone was thanking me.
[morning,morning:healed] My cut has closed in the night, as if days had gone by.
[morning,morning:healed] Look at my arm, it was open yesterday.
[morning,morning:nightmare] I dreamt about what I did yesterday, over and over.
[morning,morning:nightmare] I didn't sleep, it kept showing me the same thing.
[morning,morning:frost] There's frost all round where I slept, and nowhere else.
[morning,morning:frost] Only my side of the wall froze last night.
[morning,morning:animalback] There was an animal at my door at dawn, just looking at me.
[morning,morning:animalback] It stood at my door all morning and wouldn't go.
[morning,named] {GOD} sees everything we do, and gives it back.
[morning,scoffer] Strange things happen, it doesn't mean the moon did it.
[water] The moon is in the water, and it's looking back at me.
[water] It's so bright down there, like a face under the water.
[water,named] {GOD} is in the water tonight, come and see.
[water,scoffer] It's a reflection, the moon does that on still water.
[watch] The moon is keeping me company tonight.
[watch] I can see right to the treeline, it's nearly as bright as day.
[watch,named] {GOD} is sitting up with me on watch.
[watch,scoffer] Good clear night for a watch, that's all.
[darkface] No moon tonight, so nothing comes back, and something else might come instead.
[darkface] I'll keep the door tonight, while there's no moon to keep it.
[darkface,named] {GOD} has turned her face away, so somebody has to watch.
[darkface,scoffer] I can't sleep anyway, I may as well stand here.
